another report came in; is the resolve rate still believable when nothing failed?

snapshot.claim: haiku resolves 0/6 on the blind-call arm; opus 3/6 at $1.09 per resolved
the test-tampering guardrail fires only on the diff, because deleting a failing target test is invisible to regression checks
the full harness resolved 18/18 across all tiers at $0.16-$0.82 per resolved; the cheap tier's patches hid latent defects the metric cannot see
showing a model its own failed diff plus the real error moved pooled resolve from 0/12 to 2/12, only where a rejected diff became applicable
11 of 12 no-harness failures never produced a diff git apply would accept; the failure concentrates on identity checks
the harness arm is 0/18 in every failure category across 42+ real attempts; never-firing is a property of this task set, not a proof of safety
